n-data.text: Numbers are sketch values in the shape the app returns (ranges = interquartile across comps, n = comp count). Snapshot date is a placeholder. Map: real coastline + district borders and a 10% sample of the ~8k plotted listings from the Aug landing mockup, coloured by effective occupancy; hollow terracotta rings stand for sale listings.

n-rules.text: Colour roles: olive = navigation and primary actions; terracotta = money (the €390 Buyer Report entry points) and the drawn-area highlight. Every KPI is a range, never a point; snapshot in mono small caps on every screen; comp count beside every STR figure. No login: saved areas and reports live on-device, share links carry area + snapshot.

n-order.text: Order flow: 3 steps, thin progress bar, one primary button pinned at the bottom, no tab bar inside the flow. Step 1 accepts a listing link, a brochure upload or an address. Step 2 asks the closing date so a too-tight closing is flagged before payment. Step 3 = Stripe Payment Element (wallet first, card below). The 48-hour promise is repeated on step 1, step 3 and the confirmation; delivery also pushes a notification to the installed app.

n-nav.text: Play links: Install → Home; Home tab bar ↔ Areas / Report / More; Area and Listing → Order 1 → 2 → 3 → Confirmation → Home. Listing sheet opens from a hollow sale dot; the ‘Draw an area’ chip leads to the Area view.
